title: TuxRacer.js
tagline: Tux the penguin belly-slides down a mountain grabbing fish.
blurb: Steer Tux down the hill, grab as many fish as you can and try not to fly off a cliff. It's the old Tux Racer game rebuilt for the browser, and it starts the second it loads.
desc: TuxRacer.js by Jan Ebbe: the classic Tux Racer penguin sledding game rebuilt for the browser. Arrow keys or WASD, touch joystick on phones. Hosted on kaleerson.com.
author: Jan Ebbe
tags: penguin snow ski sled race tux linux downhill fish
extraCredit: It's a remake of Extreme Tux Racer, so the courses, music and art come from that team too.
